title: Pure Hex Sealed Fusion
summary: The Dark, The Light, and The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion paired with Dragon Effect Monsters, Rock extenders, and Polymerization. Each Hex-Sealed Fusion either substitutes for a named Fusion Material during a Fusion Summon or Tributes itself and another monster on the field to Special Summon a matching-Attribute Fusion Monster directly from the Extra Deck without Polymerization.

summary.title: Starters
points: Doki Doki discards 1 Rock monster (any Level 3 Hex-Sealed Fusion) to Special Summon a Level 3 Hex-Sealed Fusion with the same Attribute from the Deck.
Keeper of Dragon Magic discards 1 card on Normal or Special Summon to search Polymerization, and serves as a Dragon Effect Monster on the field to Tribute alongside a Hex-Sealed Fusion.

Albion the Shrouded Dragon sends Fallen of Albaz from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand (and draws 1 card if sent from hand), putting a free Dragon Effect Monster on the field without using your Normal Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Albion the Shrouded Dragon + The Dark or The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion
steps: Use Albion the Shrouded Dragon in your hand to send Fallen of Albaz from the Deck to the GY and Special Summon Albion to your field (or revive a discarded Hex-Sealed Fusion with Adamancipator Signs next to Keeper of Dragon Magic).
Normal Summon The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion (or The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion).

Tribute the Hex-Sealed Fusion and your Dragon Effect Monster on the field to Special Summon Dark Magician the Dragon Knight (with The Dark) or Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon (with The Light) directly from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Tribute Cheat vs. Proper Fusion Summon
summary.text: Each Hex-Sealed Fusion has two distinct applications. Its Ignition Effect Tributes itself and the other required material(s) from your field to Special Summon a DARK, LIGHT, or EARTH Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck—Summoning Dark Magician the Dragon Knight, Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon, Millennium-Eyes Restrict, Invoked Caliga, or Ryu Senshi without a Fusion Spell. When paired with Polymerization (or Lubellion the Searing Dragon), its substitute effect replaces a specifically named material like Aleister the Invoker or Dark Magician to properly Fusion Summon Invoked Mechaba or Red-Eyes Slash Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Dark Magician the Dragon Knight (The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion standing in for Dark Magician, plus a Dragon) is treated as Dark Magician and keeps the opponent from targeting or destroying your Spells and Traps.
Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon is unaffected by Trap Cards or effects, can attack all monsters the opponent controls once each, and resets a Trap from the GY after battling.

Millennium-Eyes Restrict (Tributed out with The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any Effect Monster) equips an opponent's monster when they activate a monster effect to negate monsters with that name, while Invoked Caliga locks both players to 1 monster effect and 1 attack per turn, and Invoked Mechaba provides omni-negation.

summary.title: Spells
points: Adamancipator Signs Special Summons any Level 3 Rock Hex-Sealed Fusion from the GY in Defense Position so you can immediately switch or Tribute it alongside a Dragon on the field.
Polymerization is searched by Keeper of Dragon Magic and fuses a Hex-Sealed Fusion from the hand or field into bosses that require a proper Fusion Summon.

allow.Fallen of Albaz: Level 4 DARK Dragon: fuses with an opponent's monster on Summon, OR pairs on the field with The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion to Tribute both and cheat out Dark Magician the Dragon Knight.
allow.Albion the Shrouded Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon that Special Summons itself from the hand/GY by sending Branded Retribution/Albaz to GY, providing a free Dragon Effect Monster on the field to Tribute alongside Hex-Sealed Fusions.
allow.Keeper of Dragon Magic: Level 4 DARK Dragon that searches Polymerization and revives a named Fusion Material from the GY, AND serves as a Dragon on the field to Tribute with The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion for Dark Magician the Dragon Knight.
allow.Doki Doki: Level 2 EARTH Rock that discards a Rock (a Hex-Sealed Fusion) to Special Summon The Light, The Dark, or The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion directly from your Deck matching the discarded Attribute.
allow.Adamancipator Signs: Revives any Rock monster (The Light, The Dark, or The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion!) from your GY and stacks another Hex-Sealed Fusion on top of your Deck.
allow.Polymerization: Searched by Keeper of Dragon Magic; allows the Hex-Sealed Fusions to Fusion Summon from the hand or field into bosses that require a proper Fusion Summon.
allow.Dark Magician the Dragon Knight: Level 8 DARK Dragon Fusion (Dark Magician + 1 Dragon): The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion stands in for Dark Magician and tributes itself with Keeper of Dragon Magic or Albion the Shrouded Dragon to summon it without Polymerization. Replaces Dark Magician the Dragon Knight, Forbidden since October 2026.
allow.Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon: Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion boss summoned without Polymerization by Tributing The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any Dragon on the field.
allow.Millennium-Eyes Restrict: Level 1 DARK Spellcaster Fusion boss summoned without Polymerization by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any Effect Monster on the field to absorb and negate opposing monsters.
allow.Invoked Caliga: Level 4 DARK Beast Fusion boss summoned by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any DARK monster on the field to restrict both players to 1 monster effect and 1 attack per turn.
allow.Invoked Mechaba: Level 9 LIGHT Machine Fusion boss summoned via Polymerization using The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any LIGHT monster for omni-negation.
allow.Lubellion the Searing Dragon: Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion summoned via Fallen of Albaz + 1 DARK monster to shuffle materials into the Deck for Fusion Summons.
allow.Ryu Senshi: Level 6 EARTH Warrior Fusion boss summoned by Tributing The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion + a Warrior/Fiend on field to negate Normal Traps and targeting Spells.
allow.Cyber Twin Dragon: Cyber Twin Dragon: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.
allow.Red-Eyes Slash Dragon: Red-Eyes Slash Dragon: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.

main: Level 3 DARK Rock: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material, OR tributes itself + 1 other material on the field without Polymerization to Special Summon Dark Magician the Dragon Knight, Millennium-Eyes Restrict, or Invoked Caliga!
Level 3 LIGHT Rock: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material, OR tributes itself + 1 Dragon on the field without Polymerization to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon!
Level 3 EARTH Rock: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material, OR tributes itself + 1 other material on the field without Polymerization to Special Summon an EARTH Fusion Monster.

Level 4 DARK Dragon Effect Monster: discards 1 card on Normal/Special Summon to search Polymerization, AND serves as the exact '1 Dragon monster' on the field to Tribute alongside The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion for Dark Magician the Dragon Knight!
Level 4 DARK Dragon Effect Monster: fuses with an opponent's monster into Lubellion, or Tributes on the field with a Hex-Sealed Fusion.
Level 8 DARK Dragon Effect Monster: sends Fallen of Albaz from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand, giving you a free Dragon on the field to Tribute alongside a Hex-Sealed Fusion!
Level 2 EARTH Rock: discards 1 Rock monster to Special Summon a Rock monster with the same Attribute and Level from your Deck.
Special Summons any Rock monster (The Dark, The Light, or The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion) from your GY with 0 Normal Summon cost.

Searched by Keeper of Dragon Magic; fuses a Hex-Sealed Fusion with another material from your hand or field to Fusion Summon Invoked Mechaba, Dark Magician the Dragon Knight, or Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon.
extra: DARK Fusion summoned by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion (as Dark Magician) + a Dragon on the field; the opponent can't target or destroy your Spells and Traps.

3400 ATK LIGHT Dragon Fusion boss: summoned by Tributing The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + 1 Dragon on the field (no Polymerization needed!) or via Polymerization; unaffected by Trap Cards and attacks all opponent's monsters.

Level 1 DARK Fusion boss: summoned by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + ANY Effect Monster on the field (no Polymerization needed!); equips an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect when they activate a monster effect.

Level 4 DARK Fusion boss: summoned by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any DARK monster on the field (no Polymerization needed!) to restrict both players to 1 monster effect and 1 attack per turn.
Level 9 LIGHT Machine Fusion boss: summoned via Polymerization using The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + another LIGHT monster; discards a card type to negate and banish that card type.
Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion summoned via Fallen of Albaz + a DARK monster; discards 1 card to shuffle materials from your field/GY into the Deck for Fusion Summons.
Level 6 EARTH Warrior Fusion boss for The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion that negates Normal Traps and targeting Spells.
Level 8 Fusion: 2800 ATK machine that attacks twice during each Battle Phase.
Level 7 Fusion: equips Warriors from GY when a Red-Eyes attacks, and sends equipped cards to negate cards/effects that target your cards.
